mapper.select: SELECT SESSION_ID, TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS START_TIME FROM CONCERT_SESSION WHERE CONCERT_ID = #{concertId} ORDER BY START_TIME ASC

SELECT s.SEAT_ID, s.SECTION, s.SEAT_NO, NVL(ss.STATUS, 'AVAILABLE') AS STATUS FROM SEAT s JOIN CONCERT_SESSION cs ON s.VENUE_ID = (SELECT VENUE_ID FROM CONCERT WHERE CONCERT_ID = cs.CONCERT_ID) LEFT JOIN SEAT_STATUS ss ON s.SEAT_ID = ss.SEAT_ID AND ss.SESSION_ID = cs.SESSION_ID WHERE cs.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} ORDER BY s.SECTION ASC, s.SEAT_NO ASC
SELECT TITLE FROM CONCERT WHERE CONCERT_ID = #{concertId}
SELECT v.NAME FROM CONCERT c JOIN VENUE v ON c.VENUE_ID = v.VENUE_ID WHERE c.CONCERT_ID = #{concertId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT_STATUS WHERE LOCKED_BY = #{userId} AND SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEAT_STATUS (SESSION_ID, SEAT_ID, STATUS, LOCKED_AT, LOCKED_BY, EXPIRES_AT) SELECT #{sessionId}, #{seatId}, 'LOCKED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SEAT_STATUS WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND SEAT_ID = #{seatId} )
